scope: Independent file-level and human-readability check after retrieval to the MacBook; the videos are visualization-only derivatives of frozen qpos/qvel trajectories.

visual_check.time_alignment: frame 0 contains sim_time_s=0.01, so media PTS is 0.01 s behind the displayed simulation time
visual_check.observed: Both branches visibly show the upper body, right arm, palm marker and translucent panel edge; the overlay shows the same 38.11 N contact event while MCC alpha is 0.000 versus 0.050.
visual_check.boundary: This fixes human readability only. It does not create new numeric evidence and does not replace the trajectory audit.

frame_hash_boundary: The changing time/force overlay contributes to every decoded frame hash. The 1200 unique hashes prove decodability and non-identical complete bitmaps, not by themselves underlying robot motion; motion evidence remains in the numeric trajectory and human video inspection.
